observations: Light blue industrial drilling machine with chipped paint and surface rust
Control panel with switches, buttons, and indicator lights visible in photos 0 and 1
Ribbed electric motor mounted on the side in photos 0 and 1; finned motor in photo 2
Drill chuck and spindle visible at the bottom in photos 1 and 2
Work table and base visible in photo 2
"POSTED ON JIJI ANI JOSEPH" watermark across all photos

claims.claim: Drilling machine in very good condition no issues
claims.evidence: Photos show wear but cannot confirm mechanical or electrical function

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may be underpowered
risks.proof: Video of the machine running under load

risks.risk: Spindle or chuck may be worn, wobbly, or unable to grip bits
risks.proof: Close-up video of the chuck rotating and holding a drill bit

risks.risk: Control switches or electrical wiring may be faulty
risks.proof: Video showing each switch and button operating

risks.risk: Radial arm or column may be seized or damaged
risks.proof: Video of the arm moving along its full travel

proof_requests: Video of the motor running and the spindle rotating
Close-up of the chuck gripping and releasing a drill bit
Demonstration of each control switch and button
Video of the radial arm moving through its full range
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used industrial drilling machine, so it can be priced at its worst case based on visible wear and unproven function.
